findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: retrieve_part_url · Private data: create_asset_direct_upload, thumbnail_upload, upload_subtitles, asset_audio_upload, complete_audio_upload, create_webhook, list_sources, list_workspaces, invite_channel_viewers_csv · Public sink: create_asset_direct_upload, thumbnail_upload, upload_subtitles, complete_subtitle_upload, asset_audio_upload, complete_audio_upload, retrieve_part_url, complete_multipart_upload, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook, thumbnail_upload_live, remove_channel_viewers, webhook_history, multipart_upload_abort, multipart_upload_list · Destructive: delete_asset, delete_profile, remove_asset_playlist, delete_playlist, delete_webhook, delete_source, delete_live_asset, delete_workspace, delete_folder, remove_assets_folder, remove_channel_viewers, assets_delete_many, assets_tag_many, live_workspace_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: retrieve_part_url · Private data: create_asset_direct_upload, thumbnail_upload, upload_subtitles, asset_audio_upload, complete_audio_upload, create_webhook, list_sources, list_workspaces, invite_channel_viewers_csv · Public sink: create_asset_direct_upload, thumbnail_upload, upload_subtitles, complete_subtitle_upload, asset_audio_upload, complete_audio_upload, retrieve_part_url, complete_multipart_upload, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook, thumbnail_upload_live, remove_channel_viewers, webhook_history, multipart_upload_abort, multipart_upload_list · Destructive: delete_asset, delete_profile, remove_asset_playlist, delete_playlist, delete_webhook, delete_source, delete_live_asset, delete_workspace, delete_folder, remove_assets_folder, remove_channel_viewers, assets_delete_many, assets_tag_many, live_workspace_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
